1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said light emitting diodes are mounted on outwardly facing side surfaces of the columnar body and said fins extend radially from corners of the columnar body between adjacent side surfaces carrying said light emitting diodes.__

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __to permit airflow through the hollow columnar body.__

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __said optic element being disposed between adjacent fins.__

4. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material.

5. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body, __with at least one diode on each outwardly facing side surface.__

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes.

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section, __the cross-section defining a corresponding plurality of outwardly facing side surfaces and corners.__

8. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

9. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body, __each fin being positioned between adjacent faces.__

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face.

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, __and are integrally formed as a one-piece heat sink.__

12. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element __that__ is disposed between each adjacent fin over-lapping said diode.

13. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current, __said printed circuit board being disposed within the hollow columnar body.__

15. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, __wherein said second end is open to permit airflow through said body.__

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode, __wherein said extruding forms a polygonal body having outwardly facing side walls and integral radially extending fins at corners of the body.__

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls, __said side walls defining faces adapted to receive respective light emitting diodes.__
